8285struct OperatorCode FLATBUFFERS_FINAL_CLASS : private ::flatbuffers::Table {
8286 typedef OperatorCodeBuilder Builder;
8287 enum FlatBuffersVTableOffset FLATBUFFERS_VTABLE_UNDERLYING_TYPE {
8288 VT_DEPRECATED_BUILTIN_CODE = 4,
8289 VT_CUSTOM_CODE = 6,
8290 VT_VERSION = 8,
8291 VT_BUILTIN_CODE = 10
8292 };
8293 int8_t deprecated_builtin_code() const {
8294 return GetField<int8_t>(VT_DEPRECATED_BUILTIN_CODE, 0);
8295 }
8296 const ::flatbuffers::String *custom_code() const {
8297 return GetPointer<const ::flatbuffers::String *>(VT_CUSTOM_CODE);
8298 }
8299 int32_t version() const {
8300 return GetField<int32_t>(VT_VERSION, 1);
8301 }
8302 opencv_tflite::BuiltinOperator builtin_code() const {
8303 return static_cast<opencv_tflite::BuiltinOperator>(GetField<int32_t>(VT_BUILTIN_CODE, 0));
8304 }
8305 bool Verify(::flatbuffers::Verifier &verifier) const {
8306 return VerifyTableStart(verifier) &&
8307 VerifyField<int8_t>(verifier, VT_DEPRECATED_BUILTIN_CODE, 1) &&
8308 VerifyOffset(verifier, VT_CUSTOM_CODE) &&
8309 verifier.VerifyString(custom_code()) &&
8310 VerifyField<int32_t>(verifier, VT_VERSION, 4) &&
8311 VerifyField<int32_t>(verifier, VT_BUILTIN_CODE, 4) &&
8312 verifier.EndTable();
8313 }
8314};

8316struct OperatorCodeBuilder {
8317 typedef OperatorCode Table;
8318 ::flatbuffers::FlatBufferBuilder &fbb_;
8319 ::flatbuffers::uoffset_t start_;
8320 void add_deprecated_builtin_code(int8_t deprecated_builtin_code) {
8321 fbb_.AddElement<int8_t>(OperatorCode::VT_DEPRECATED_BUILTIN_CODE, deprecated_builtin_code, 0);
8322 }
8323 void add_custom_code(::flatbuffers::Offset<::flatbuffers::String> custom_code) {
8324 fbb_.AddOffset(OperatorCode::VT_CUSTOM_CODE, custom_code);
8325 }
8326 void add_version(int32_t version) {
8327 fbb_.AddElement<int32_t>(OperatorCode::VT_VERSION, version, 1);
8328 }
8329 void add_builtin_code(opencv_tflite::BuiltinOperator builtin_code) {
8330 fbb_.AddElement<int32_t>(OperatorCode::VT_BUILTIN_CODE, static_cast<int32_t>(builtin_code), 0);
8331 }
8332 explicit OperatorCodeBuilder(::flatbuffers::FlatBufferBuilder &_fbb)
8333 : fbb_(_fbb) {
8334 start_ = fbb_.StartTable();
8335 }
8336 ::flatbuffers::Offset<OperatorCode> Finish() {

8338 auto o = ::flatbuffers::Offset<OperatorCode>(end);

8342
8343inline ::flatbuffers::Offset<OperatorCode> CreateOperatorCode(
8344 ::flatbuffers::FlatBufferBuilder &_fbb,
8345 int8_t deprecated_builtin_code = 0,
8346 ::flatbuffers::Offset<::flatbuffers::String> custom_code = 0,
8347 int32_t version = 1,
8348 opencv_tflite::BuiltinOperator builtin_code = opencv_tflite::BuiltinOperator_ADD) {
8349 OperatorCodeBuilder builder_(_fbb);
8350 builder_.add_builtin_code(builtin_code);
8351 builder_.add_version(version);
8352 builder_.add_custom_code(custom_code);
8353 builder_.add_deprecated_builtin_code(deprecated_builtin_code);
8354 return builder_.Finish();
8355}
8356
8357inline ::flatbuffers::Offset<OperatorCode> CreateOperatorCodeDirect(
8358 ::flatbuffers::FlatBufferBuilder &_fbb,
8359 int8_t deprecated_builtin_code = 0,
8360 const char *custom_code = nullptr,
8361 int32_t version = 1,
8362 opencv_tflite::BuiltinOperator builtin_code = opencv_tflite::BuiltinOperator_ADD) {
8363 auto custom_code__ = custom_code ? _fbb.CreateString(custom_code) : 0;
8364 return opencv_tflite::CreateOperatorCode(
8365 _fbb,
8366 deprecated_builtin_code,
8367 custom_code__,
8368 version,
8369 builtin_code);
8370}

8772 }

8775 }
8776 const ::flatbuffers::Vector<uint8_t> *mutating_variable_inputs() const {
8777 return GetPointer<const ::flatbuffers::Vector<uint8_t> *>(VT_MUTATING_VARIABLE_INPUTS);
8778 }
8779 const ::flatbuffers::Vector<int32_t> *intermediates() const {
8780 return GetPointer<const ::flatbuffers::Vector<int32_t> *>(VT_INTERMEDIATES);
8781 }
8782 bool Verify(::flatbuffers::Verifier &verifier) const {
8783 return VerifyTableStart(verifier) &&
8784 VerifyField<uint32_t>(verifier, VT_OPCODE_INDEX, 4) &&
8785 VerifyOffset(verifier, VT_INPUTS) &&
8786 verifier.VerifyVector(inputs()) &&
8787 VerifyOffset(verifier, VT_OUTPUTS) &&
8788 verifier.VerifyVector(outputs()) &&
8789 VerifyField<uint8_t>(verifier, VT_BUILTIN_OPTIONS_TYPE, 1) &&
8790 VerifyOffset(verifier, VT_BUILTIN_OPTIONS) &&
8791 VerifyBuiltinOptions(verifier, builtin_options(), builtin_options_type()) &&
8792 VerifyOffset(verifier, VT_CUSTOM_OPTIONS) &&
8793 verifier.VerifyVector(custom_options()) &&
8794 VerifyField<int8_t>(verifier, VT_CUSTOM_OPTIONS_FORMAT, 1) &&
8795 VerifyOffset(verifier, VT_MUTATING_VARIABLE_INPUTS) &&
8796 verifier.VerifyVector(mutating_variable_inputs()) &&
8797 VerifyOffset(verifier, VT_INTERMEDIATES) &&
8798 verifier.VerifyVector(intermediates()) &&
8799 verifier.EndTable();
8800 }
8801};

9295struct OperatorBuilder {
9296 typedef Operator Table;
9297 ::flatbuffers::FlatBufferBuilder &fbb_;
9298 ::flatbuffers::uoffset_t start_;
9299 void add_opcode_index(uint32_t opcode_index) {
9300 fbb_.AddElement<uint32_t>(Operator::VT_OPCODE_INDEX, opcode_index, 0);
9301 }
9302 void add_inputs(::flatbuffers::Offset<::flatbuffers::Vector<int32_t>> inputs) {
9303 fbb_.AddOffset(Operator::VT_INPUTS, inputs);
9304 }
9305 void add_outputs(::flatbuffers::Offset<::flatbuffers::Vector<int32_t>> outputs) {
9306 fbb_.AddOffset(Operator::VT_OUTPUTS, outputs);
9307 }
9308 void add_builtin_options_type(opencv_tflite::BuiltinOptions builtin_options_type) {
9309 fbb_.AddElement<uint8_t>(Operator::VT_BUILTIN_OPTIONS_TYPE, static_cast<uint8_t>(builtin_options_type), 0);
9310 }
9311 void add_builtin_options(::flatbuffers::Offset<void> builtin_options) {
9312 fbb_.AddOffset(Operator::VT_BUILTIN_OPTIONS, builtin_options);
9313 }
9314 void add_custom_options(::flatbuffers::Offset<::flatbuffers::Vector<uint8_t>> custom_options) {
9315 fbb_.AddOffset(Operator::VT_CUSTOM_OPTIONS, custom_options);
9316 }
9317 void add_custom_options_format(opencv_tflite::CustomOptionsFormat custom_options_format) {
9318 fbb_.AddElement<int8_t>(Operator::VT_CUSTOM_OPTIONS_FORMAT, static_cast<int8_t>(custom_options_format), 0);
9319 }
9320 void add_mutating_variable_inputs(::flatbuffers::Offset<::flatbuffers::Vector<uint8_t>> mutating_variable_inputs) {
9321 fbb_.AddOffset(Operator::VT_MUTATING_VARIABLE_INPUTS, mutating_variable_inputs);
9322 }
9323 void add_intermediates(::flatbuffers::Offset<::flatbuffers::Vector<int32_t>> intermediates) {
9324 fbb_.AddOffset(Operator::VT_INTERMEDIATES, intermediates);
9325 }
9326 explicit OperatorBuilder(::flatbuffers::FlatBufferBuilder &_fbb)
9327 : fbb_(_fbb) {
9328 start_ = fbb_.StartTable();
9329 }
9330 ::flatbuffers::Offset<Operator> Finish() {
9331 const auto end = fbb_.EndTable(start_);
9332 auto o = ::flatbuffers::Offset<Operator>(end);
9333 return o;
9334 }
9335};
9336
9337inline ::flatbuffers::Offset<Operator> CreateOperator(
9338 ::flatbuffers::FlatBufferBuilder &_fbb,
9339 uint32_t opcode_index = 0,
9340 ::flatbuffers::Offset<::flatbuffers::Vector<int32_t>> inputs = 0,
9341 ::flatbuffers::Offset<::flatbuffers::Vector<int32_t>> outputs = 0,
9342 opencv_tflite::BuiltinOptions builtin_options_type = opencv_tflite::BuiltinOptions_NONE,
9343 ::flatbuffers::Offset<void> builtin_options = 0,
9344 ::flatbuffers::Offset<::flatbuffers::Vector<uint8_t>> custom_options = 0,
9345 opencv_tflite::CustomOptionsFormat custom_options_format = opencv_tflite::CustomOptionsFormat_FLEXBUFFERS,
9346 ::flatbuffers::Offset<::flatbuffers::Vector<uint8_t>> mutating_variable_inputs = 0,
9347 ::flatbuffers::Offset<::flatbuffers::Vector<int32_t>> intermediates = 0) {
9348 OperatorBuilder builder_(_fbb);
9349 builder_.add_intermediates(intermediates);
9350 builder_.add_mutating_variable_inputs(mutating_variable_inputs);
